# The input is the sheet's example as printed. The Postal expectation is the sheet's own text, except where the sheet's typography or the country line differ: Portugal's postcode dash is a hyphen, San Marino's country line is SAN MARINO,
# the Vatican locality is in capitals, Andorra's Spanish office example ends in ANDORRA (the sheet prints ANDORRE for the Spanish post office).

# Sources: UPU country sheets (upu.int, addressing unit): United Kingdom 11/2011, Jersey 03/2005, Guernsey 03/2005, Isle of Man 03/2005, Ireland 06/2017, Spain 01/2013, Portugal 10/2024, Italy 04/2020, San Marino 10/2010, Vatican 03/2005, Malta, Andorra 09/2004.
